name: Nandyal

queries.query: Nandyal Andhra Pradesh official GIS cadastral parcel map survey land records
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Government of Andhra Pradesh BhuNaksha cadastral viewer, Nandyal district official Land Records/MRO page, APSAC state GIS/cadastral entry point, and Government of India DILRMP Nandyal district map/ULPIN coverage. The official public viewer was identified, but no safe anonymous Nandyal parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.

queries.query: నంద్యాల భూ రికార్డులు GIS పార్సెల్ మ్యాప్ అధికారిక
queries.result: Telugu-language discovery located the official Andhra Pradesh BhuNaksha portal and confirmed the public workflow is district/mandal/village/survey-number based. No native parcel identity, geometry, schema, or CRS response was obtained.

researchNote: An official local custodian route is evidenced by the Nandyal district administration Land Records page identifying the MRO office, supported by the Government of Andhra Pradesh BhuNaksha portal and the Survey, Settlements and Land Records department. This packet records source research only; it is not source integration or admission.
